f07.fig_benchmark.callout: The three consumer reporting agencies received 86.6% of all complaints and closed almost none with monetary relief, because a credit report is corrected rather than refunded. Among the rest, BANK OF AMERICA, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION closed the largest share with money, 23.4%. Real companies, real public data, exactly as the Bureau publishes it; a count of complaints is not a measure of how a company treats its customers.
